window.label: Character profile
window.needsDesktop: Character profiles are read by the desktop app. This preview shows sample data.
window.emptyHint: Use the profile button beside a name in the DPS meter, the Live table or a report's Deaths tab.
window.hiddenHint: Profiles name a character, so they stay closed while Hide character names is on in Settings.
window.source: Public data from NCSOFT's official AION 2 character service, read when you open or refresh a profile.
window.focusDenied: Windows kept the game in front, so it may still be holding the mouse. Free the cursor in the game, then use this window.

actions.refreshTitle: Read this character again from the official service
actions.copyTitle: Copy one line with this character's name, class, server, Combat Power and item level
actions.shugoTitle: Open {{name}} on Shugo.gg in your browser
actions.shareTitle: Copy this character's Shugo.gg profile link or a one-line summary
actions.linkFailed: The profile link could not be copied: {{reason}}
actions.copyFailed: The summary could not be copied: {{reason}}

state.loadingHint: Looking up the exact name on its server, then its sheet and equipment.
state.noEquipment: The official service sent no equipment for this character.

invalid.title: This character cannot be looked up
invalid.hint: Profiles need a character name and Global server seen together in the game.

not_found.title: No public profile found
not_found.hint: The official service lists no character with exactly this name on this server. It may have been renamed, moved or deleted.

private.title: This profile is private
private.hint: The official service does not share this character's profile.

rate_limited.title: The official service asked to slow down
rate_limited.hint: Wait a moment before trying again.

unavailable.title: The official service did not answer as expected
unavailable.hint: It may be under maintenance. Try again later.

network.title: The official service could not be reached
network.hint: Check your connection, then try again.

equipment.chooseHint: Optional: click the slot to keep these details open beside the list.

arcana.chooseHint: Optional: click the card to keep these details open beside the cards.
arcana.noEffects: The cards list no equipped effects.
arcana.noSets: The cards belong to no set.

item.subStatsRandom: Rolled at random when the item was made.
item.noDetail: The official service publishes no further details for this item.

skills.bonuses: Level bonuses named by the service
skills.noBonuses: None in what has been read so far.
skills.bonusesScope: Counts the open Daevanion boards and the items opened in this profile.
skills.unpublished: Descriptions, cost, cooldown, cast time, range and specialties are not shown: NCSOFT's public character service lists only each skill's name, icon, level, unlock level and learned or slotted state.
skills.specialtiesUnknown: The service does not publish which specialties this character chose, so none are shown.
skills.empty: The official service listed no skills.

daevanion.none: The official service listed no Daevanion boards.
daevanion.lockedHint: This board is not open yet; its {{total}} nodes are shown as the service lists them.
daevanion.boardLabel: Board nodes. Drag to move, Ctrl and the wheel to zoom.
daevanion.howTo: Arrow keys move between nodes; Enter shows a node's effects.
daevanion.noOpenEffects: No node of this board is open.

stats.title: Character stats
stats.none: The official service listed no stats.
stats.wheelLabel: Divine stats on the outer ring, base stats around the compass in its centre
stats.notListed: The official service did not list this stat.
stats.combatUnavailable: The official service publishes these stats, titles and node bonuses, not the combined combat sheet (attack, defense, critical hit and the rest), so no total is shown.

saved.fullTitle: Saved characters are full. Remove one to save another.
saved.none: No saved characters yet. Use the star on a profile to save it.
saved.failed: The saved characters could not be changed: {{reason}}
saved.openFailed: That saved character could not be opened: {{reason}}
